sections.heading: Bandwidth ordering
sections.text: Inner current loop crossover: f_ci ~ fsw/10 to fsw/5. Outer voltage loop crossover: f_cv = 10-20 Hz (must stay below 2*f_line). The voltage loop must be slow enough to not distort the sinusoidal current reference.

sections.heading: Current loop tuning
sections.text: The current loop tracks a sinusoidal reference. The plant is a boost inductor with variable duty cycle. Set kp for the desired crossover frequency: kp ~ 2*pi*f_ci*L_boost/Vout. Add ki for zero steady-state error at the line frequency.

sections.heading: Voltage loop tuning
sections.text: The voltage loop regulates the bulk capacitor. kp ~ 2*pi*f_cv*C_bulk/Vout. ki ~ kp*f_cv/5. The voltage loop output is the current amplitude — it multiplies with the rectified line voltage shape to generate the current reference.

sections.heading: THD considerations
sections.text: If THD is high, increase current-loop bandwidth. If the current loop is too slow, the current waveform distorts at the zero crossings of the line voltage. The current-loop phase margin at 2*f_line determines the power factor.
